comments.author: @VidaRealViajes
comments.text: Taking a proper Fika break with a warm cup of black coffee and a fresh cinnamon bun is such a grounded daily ritual. Traditional Swedish comfort food like savory meatballs and pickled herring reflects that practical, unpretentious way of eating. It is refreshing to see a food culture centered around simplicity and cozy routine rather than over-the-top excess.
